# Case studies

How do a research question, sources and modelling decisions limit a digital project's claims? This catalogue distinguishes project description, inspected evidence and local testing. Public source code does not itself grant reuse permission.

[Critical case-study template](../contribute/project-template.md) · [Dated audit of every case](https://github.com/damjan-popic/digital-humanities-handbook/blob/main/release/case-study-audit.md) · [Metadata vocabulary and limits](https://github.com/damjan-popic/digital-humanities-handbook/blob/main/data/case-study-metadata.md)

**11 cases; 11 English pages; 0 Slovene pages; 11 English fallbacks.**

## Reading the labels

Audited legacy cases are not v1-complete. The dated audit records gaps and follow-up work; a reachable website does not prove maintenance, and a code licence does not settle rights in all inputs. Archived, unavailable and deferred cases remain visible, not recommendations to run unchecked software.
